odc_type: Incorrect state management during dependency injection
observation_summary: A mock object was injected into multiple fields when it should have been injected only once, leading to incorrect object state in the target class.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurred because the dependency injection engine was not tracking which mocks had already been successfully injected into the target object. When multiple fields were eligible for injection, the engine would repeatedly inject the same mock into all matching fields rather than consuming the mock once it was used. The fix introduces a mechanism to remove the successfully injected mock from the set of available candidates, ensuring each mock is injected only once and preventing subsequent fields from incorrectly receiving an already-injected mock.
